rule.name: JpaIdentityHashCode
rule.message: Return getClass().hashCode() from the hashCode of an entity, or hash an immutable business key; with Lombok, write @EqualsAndHashCode(onlyExplicitlyIncluded = true) and mark that key with @EqualsAndHashCode.Include. A hash of the generated id or of every field changes when the entity is saved, and a hash set then loses it.
